The table below gives some values of a continuous function $f(x)$ on the closed interval $[-2,4].$ The right Riemann sum approximation to the area under the curve $y=f(x)$ with $3$ equal subintervals has a value of $22.$ What must be the value of $k?$

| $x$ | $-2$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $3$ | $k$ | $5$ | $3$ |
feedback.worked_solution:
The area $A$ under the graph can be approximated using the formula

$$
A≈(\overset{\text{heights}}{\overset{⏞}{f(0)+f(2)+f(4)}})\cdot {{Δx}_{⏟}}_{\text{width}}.
$$

Let's set up a table with the values of $f(x)$ at each point:

| $x$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $k$ | $5$ | $3$ |

Now, we obtain the following approximation for the area:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & ≈(k+5+3)\cdot 2 \\  & =(k+8)\cdot 2 \\  & =2k+16\end{aligned}
$$

Since we are given that $A$ must be $22$, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}2k+16 & =22 \\ 2k & =22-16 \\ k & =\frac{6}{2} \\ k & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
